The focus of this paper has been on the internal information complexity, and except for few results such as Proposition 6, we have not studied the external information complexity analogues. However considering that external information complexity is typically simpler than internal information complexity, we believe that the analogues of many of our results, specially those about the AND function, can be proven for this case as well. We defer this to future research.
